# Ableton SDK Vendor Files

The Ableton Extensions SDK beta tarballs are not published to npm. To install this extension locally, copy the official SDK and CLI tarballs from Ableton's SDK download into this directory:

```text
ableton-extensions-sdk-1.0.0-beta.0.tgz
ableton-extensions-cli-1.0.0-beta.0.tgz
```

They are ignored by git so this repo does not redistribute Ableton's SDK package.
